description: This file defines the CreateDatabaseSavepointController class, handling HTTP requests to create database savepoints in the OrangeHRM Testing Plugin. It processes incoming requests, invokes backup services, and returns JSON responses.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling requests to create database savepoints for testing purposes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming HTTP request to create a database savepoint, then returns a JSON response with the count of tables affected.
